data.fund_type: An open-ended Equity Scheme investing in companies following the ESG theme with exclusionary strategy.
data.investment_objective: The objective of the scheme is to provide investors with opportunities for long-term growth in capital through an active management of investments in a diversified basket of companies following Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria using exclusionary strategy. However, there is no assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved.
data.exit_load: For exit within 1 year from the date of allotment - 1%; For exit after 1 year from the date of allotment - Nil.
